articles.title: Tata Elxsi Q2 Results: Profit rises 10% YoY to Rs 170 crore; revenue grows 15%
articles.excerpt:

The rupee has appreciated against the dollar after the central bank implemented new measures to support the currency. Meanwhile, traders are anticipating US inflation data, which could influence Federal Reserve decisions.
